alert_semantics_analysis.definition: The 'is_alert' flag represents an active daily alarm state (C_t > h or x_t outside control limits), NOT an edge-triggered new threshold crossing.
alert_semantics_analysis.impact_of_reset_policy_none: Under reset_policy='none', accumulators carry forward historical state without clearing to zero upon alarm. A single macro-seasonal excursion in CUSUM (Episode 7 starting on 2012-03-07) sustained an unbroken alarm state for 300 consecutive days through 2012-12-31.

cusum_cnt_mean.finding: Because CUSUM was already in an unbroken alarm state from 2012-03-07, it experienced 0 new threshold crossings post-onset (2012-07-01). The 100% batch recall is an artifact of pre-existing seasonal saturation, not sensitivity to the +75 shift.

shewhart_cnt_mean.finding: On 2012-07-01, Shewhart was on day 4 of an ongoing summer excursion that began on 2012-06-28. The 0-day lag reflects pre-existing alarm state, not a new threshold crossing.

temp_null_rate_gx_and_pchart.finding: Clean event detection with 0 pre-onset false alarms. Detection lag is 0 days from first defect (2012-06-10) and 9 days from configured schedule start (2012-06-01).

zero_variance_cusum_status: Continuous Gaussian CUSUM is uncalibrated and mathematically invalid on Phase I temp_null_rate (sigma_0 == 0.0). Correctly excluded to avoid fabricating invalid signals.
contingency_matrix_verification: Independently verified: TP + FP + TN + FN == Total Batches (366) across all methods and scenarios without floating-point error.
